query:
UPDATE t_customer
            SET name         = COALESCE($3::varchar, name),
                serial_prefix = CASE WHEN $4::bool THEN $5::varchar ELSE serial_prefix END,
                version       = version + 1,
                updated_at    = now(),
                updated_by    = $6
            WHERE id = $1 AND version = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
